description: List the scheduled tasks on an app — what runs, how often, and whether it is on. Pass a task_id to get that task's RUN HISTORY as well, including each run's captured output and exit code: that is how you find out whether a timer is actually working, which is the whole point of it. Two catalog apps need a timer to behave correctly at all — Nextcloud wants its cron every five minutes, and WordPress's wp-cron does not fire on a site with no visitors.

task_id.description: Optional — this task plus its run history and output.

name: impreza_list_tasks
